svg.title: Edit mode's Arranger: the band, tile by tile
svg.desc: The Arranger shows the album's band at its real width over a faint grid of square cells. A toolbar holds the presets, Close gaps, Use the default, the Wide and Phone views (the phone's worked out until Arrange for phones) and Undo. The selected tile has handles that resize it by whole cells. Dropping a tile on one of the same size swaps them; otherwise the tiles below are pushed down. A hole is hatched and warned about, not refused. A live region reads each move aloud as columns and rows. Beside the canvas, a tray holds the album's items that aren't up front: drag one in to show it, or a tile out to hide it. Below, the inspector holds the selected tile's keys and buttons, and its overrides: how it's shown, its own focus, Play in the band and Hide on phones.

g.text: Presets · Close gaps · Use the default · Wide | Phone · Undo
Read aloud: columns 7 to 12, rows 1 to 2
Drag in to show, out to hide
Arrows move · Shift+arrows resize · Move and Size buttons · Fill or Fit · Remove from the band

svg.text: Every change saves, shows at once and can be undone.
